name: Azariah (son of Jeroham)
title: Military commander who helped Jehoiada
summary: Azariah, son of Jeroham, was one of the military commanders who made a covenant with the priest Jehoiada to install the young king Joash and overthrow the wicked queen Athaliah.

keyEvents.title: Helping Jehoiada install Joash as king
keyEvents.description: Azariah, son of Jeroham, was among the military commanders who made a covenant with Jehoiada to make Joash king.
